name: Premium Rewards Elite Credit Card
effective_cost: Moderate: $570 in potential credits can more than cover the fee if you use the airline, lifestyle, and Global Entry/TSA credits
balance_transfer_fee: 5% of the amount of each transaction
penalty_apr: Up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment; applies indefinitely once triggered
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $5,000 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: Keep if you'll use multiple Priority Pass memberships; steep fee otherwise

earn_note: Same 2x/2x/1.5x structure as the regular Premium Rewards card. The Elite tier's value is almost entirely in the credits and Priority Pass access, not a richer earn rate. Enrolled BofA Rewards members get a 10–75% bonus on top of these rates depending on combined deposit/investment balance. Redeeming points for airfare also gets a 20% discount versus paying cash.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a Bank of America checking or savings account
Airfare through BofA Travel at a 20% points discount
Statement credit, gift cards, or travel and concierge services

points.note: The 20% airfare discount when redeeming points is the best play here; it's the only redemption path on this card that beats a flat 1¢/point. Otherwise value tops out around 1¢/point, since there's no transfer-partner program.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: points redeem directly for cash, 20%-discounted airfare through BofA Travel, other travel, or gift cards.

credits.name: Airline Incidental Statement Credit
credits.subtitle: auto-applies · seat upgrades, bags, in-flight, lounge fees
credits.description: Up to $300 annually in statement credits for qualifying airline incidental purchases: seat upgrades, baggage fees, in-flight services, and airline lounge day-pass fees.
tips: Triple the limit on the regular Premium Rewards card ($100 vs. $300).

credits.name: Lifestyle Statement Credit
credits.subtitle: auto-applies · streaming, food delivery, fitness, rideshare
credits.description: Up to $150 annually in statement credits for video streaming services, food delivery, fitness subscriptions, and rideshare services.
tips: The broadest of the three credits, covering everyday recurring subscriptions rather than only travel-specific spend.

credits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
credits.subtitle: $120 · every 4 years
credits.description: Statement credit covering the application fee (up to $120) for Global Entry or TSA PreCheck, once every 4 years, when the fee is charged to this card. Shown here amortized to an annual figure.
tips: Apply for Global Entry rather than just TSA PreCheck; it includes TSA PreCheck and still qualifies for this credit.

insurance.detail: Reimburses the common carrier fare: no dollar limit published
$500 per ticket · after 6 hrs or an overnight stay
Covered in excess of other insurance: no dollar limit published
+1 year on warranties of 3 years or less
Up to $1M when the entire fare is on the card
Not responsible for fraudulent transactions once reported

protection_note: Bank of America's Elite benefits page lists trip delay, trip cancellation and interruption, baggage delay, lost luggage, emergency evacuation up to $100,000 and travel accident insurance up to $1,000,000. It doesn't list purchase coverage. Its older Elite benefits guide lists Purchase Security up to $10,000 within 90 days, Return Protection up to $300 per item and $1,000 a year, and a one-year warranty extension, so check your Guide to Benefits before relying on those three.
rental_note: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver is primary, up to $75,000 for collision or theft and up to the actual cash value of most rental cars. 24/7 Roadside Dispatch is included as a referral service.

status_perks.name: Priority Pass Select
status_perks.note: Up to 4 complimentary Priority Pass Select memberships. Bank of America limits enrollment to four people for the life of the account and can't swap a member out. Members and their guests get complimentary visits, though some lounges limit guest entry.

services.name: 24/7 full-service concierge
services.detail: Book travel, dinner reservations, and event tickets through a dedicated concierge line.

services.name: Visa Infinite Luxury Hotel Collection
services.detail: Late checkout, free daily breakfast for two, automatic upgrades and more at premium hotels. Some benefits depend on availability.

services.name: BofA Rewards bonus
services.detail: 10% (Member, under $30k), 25% (Preferred Plus, $30k), 50% (Preferred Honors, $100k), or 75% (Premier, $1M) bonus on points earned, set by your three-month average combined Bank of America and Merrill balance. Needs a BofA personal checking account.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)
Can be one of the up-to-4 complimentary Priority Pass memberships

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and unlike many premium cards, authorized users can share in the complimentary Priority Pass memberships rather than needing their own paid enrollment.

timeline.text: Preferred Rewards became BofA Rewards. The tiers were renamed, existing members moved over automatically, and a 10% Member tier was added. The card bonus is now 10% Member, 25% Preferred Plus, 50% Preferred Honors and 75% Premier. Cards earning a Preferred Rewards bonus before May 1, 2026 keep that bonus for at least six months. Preferred Honors and Premier also picked up subscription credits worth up to $96 and $180 a year.
